Name: Wine to Juice
Author: Stash3k
Description: I was never a big fan of the fact that I can't throw an Orange into a keg and be given an "Orange Juice" in return, so I made the change myself - now every fruit produces a juice, just as vegetables do, nothing else is changed.

Downloads.Description: Fixes the bug that would cause all your mods to crash upon creating a new game with Remixed Bundles for Community Center.

Manifest.Name: Wine to Juice
Manifest.Description: A simple content pack that changes the wine to juice
Manifest.Author: Stashek
